title: Ensuring Fair Terms in Government Contracts
what_it_is: Ensuring Fair Terms in Government Contracts

sections.label: MOF contract templates for agencies
sections.summary: MOF provides agencies with templates on contractual terms and conditions for common types of buys.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: To guide agencies, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) provides templates on the contractual terms and conditions for common types of buys which agencies make.

sections.label: IT contract terms and liquidated damages
sections.summary: IT procurement terms were amended so replacement vendors are compensated at fair market value, and liquidated damages should not exceed actual losses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For example, following industry feedback, our IT procurement contract terms were amended so that when the original equipment manufacturer's vendor defaults, the replacement vendor is compensated at prevailing fair market value instead of having to accept the previous vendor's rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: We have clear guidelines to agencies that liquidated damages should not exceed actual damages/losses suffered in the event of a breach.

sections.label: Avoiding contractual non-fulfilment, training officers
sections.summary: Agencies and contractors should avoid problems escalating to contractual non-fulfilment, and training modules guide officers on tender specifications.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As far as possible, agencies and contractors are not to let problems escalate to the point where contractual non-fulfilment is reached.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: There are training modules that guide officers on how to write the tender specifications or the scope of work expected of the tenderer.

sections.label: Auditing tender specifications, MOF guidance
sections.summary: Audits of tender specification fairness must consider procurement context, and MOF works with lead agencies and DesignSingapore Council on guidance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Given the differences across industries and situation in which a procurement is made, any audit on whether the tender specifications are fair would have to take into account the context and the circumstances when the particular procurement is called.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: To address concerns about appropriate contract clauses, MOF works with lead agencies for the major categories of buys that the Government spends on, and provide guidance to agencies and procurement officers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Similarly, MOF is working with DesignSingapore Council to advise Government agencies on best practices for procurement of design services.

sections.label: Courts striking down unfair contracts
sections.summary: When a contract is particularly unfair and crosses a line, Courts may strike it down under the Unfair Contract Terms Act.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But when a contract is particularly unfair and crosses a particular line, then, in some cases, in the Courts, the Courts will strike it down.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We do have the Unfair Contract Terms Act.
